evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Arden says 'in order for us to build a an accurate estimate ma'am, I might need to ask you a few questions that might take around ten to fifteen minutes' — mentions time frame but skips the promise-of-dependable-quote framing and doesn't wait for explicit yes before plunging into logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Lela Smith), moving day (October 3rd Saturday), route (Carrollton apartment to Little Elm house), size (1500 sq ft apartment) — all four covered.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves directly into logistics probing ('are we going to get items from your balcony or garage storage unit') without first asking 'what are your biggest concerns about this move.'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment to house), floor (first floor apartment, one-story house), rooms (three bedrooms both locations), parking (drive-up apartment, driveway house), special considerations (treadmill, refrigerator, four TVs). Did NOT ask about additional rooms, walking distance, or other stops — partial coverage.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Yes: 'would you need help packing or everything will be packed once we get there?' Customer says everything already packed.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Yes: 'box count is within 45 to 55 pieces. How many total number of box do you think are we going to move for you?'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full: 'typically for a bedroom your size it usually takes two movers between six to eight hours' (range anchor) + 'In your case since we're going to be moving you from a first floor apartment with few special items...treadmill your fridge, your four TVs...one story house which around 45 to fifty minutes away...I'm estimating them to take around seven and a half to eight and a half hours' (personalized to customer specifics: property type, floor level, special items, distance).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full: Hourly rate disclosed ($218/hour for two movers), 2.5-hour minimum + 15-minute increments covered ('once we go over the minimum the time will be rated in fifteen minutes'), transportation fee disclosed ($75), no hidden fees emphasized ('there's gonna be no hidden fee, no credit card fee, no terrible fees').
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep never asks 'does that feel fair?' or any comparable close question after presenting the estimate.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full: 'we also have an on time guarantee ma'am. Once the movers arrive late you start to get discount. The later they arrive the bigger discount will be' — covers the discount-for-lateness framing.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Full: '$2,000 free evaluation coverage. So, if anything gets damaged gets broken you can give us a call to file a claim for them zero deductible we're either gonna repair, replace or reimbursed' — covers $2,000 amount, zero deductible, and built-in framing.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep delivers both promises but never circles back with 'does that put those to rest?' or equivalent confirm. Moves directly to 'Does that all make sense?' which is a generic process check, not a closure on the two promises themselves.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Throwaway: 'Do you have any questions for me or any more clarification that you'd like to know?' — empty generic ask that invites automatic 'no,' not a genuine 'what's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: No. Never asks 'anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or similar.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Rep confirms the Saturday 3 October time slot and says 'you're all good. Before I send your confirmation email or kickoff email. Do you have any questions for me...' but never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' — the call ends without an explicit ask for the business.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: No mention of rate lock or no-deposit guarantee.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Confirmed: date (Saturday October 3rd), arrival window (8:30 to 9:00), crew size (two movers implied but not stated), addresses (origin and destination covered). Missing: phone number confirmation, crew notes about customer concerns (treadmill, TVs, fragile items, distance).

top_strength: Arden gathered all core discovery basics cleanly (name, date, size, route, property type, floors, parking, special items) and delivered both promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) with full clarity and correct framing.
coaching_note: Never asked the customer 'what are your biggest concerns about this move?' at the start of Section 2, jumped straight to logistics probing, and critically never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' — the explicit ask for the business is missing entirely, leaving the sale unasked.
